answer: Pay late, claw back early. Every reward a new key earns sits locked for 30 epochs before it vests, like a walnut tree that bears nothing for years after planting. If an audit later links that key to a farm, the whole unvested pile is burned, not just the latest payout. A farmer planting an orchard of 200 keys must fund a long voyage of upkeep with no harvest, and one exposure wipes every tree at once. Tradeoff: honest newcomers wait weeks for spendable income, which can drive some away early.
